Since you are experiencing issues with mobile data while abroad, I can suggest checking a few things on your device that might help diagnose the problem.

You can use the following diagnostic actions on your phone:
1.  **`check_network_status()`**: This will show your connection status to cellular networks, including whether data roaming is enabled.
2.  **`check_status_bar()`**: This will show you the icons currently visible in your status bar, which can indicate signal strength and data status.
3.  **`check_network_mode_preference()`**: This will show what type of cellular network your phone prefers to connect to.
